gaps: No studio-label jukebox titled for jaymala or varmala songs exists. Jaymala is covered by bride-entry lists, entry mashups and varmala films (themes such as Ram Ram Jai Raja Ram and Siya Ke Ram) instead.
Groom-entry lists are thin: only short creator lists and single songs, no chaptered label jukebox.
Reception and couple-entry songs appear only as general romantic jukeboxes and mashups; no reception-specific chaptered list from a label was found.
Pheras: only live musical-phera showreels and single songs (Ram Sita 14 Phere, Kanyadaan song); no jukebox, since pheras are normally mantra-led.
Matkor, kohbar, imli-ghotai and gaali geet have no Bollywood-style lists. They exist only as Bhojpuri and Maithili folk uploads, which belong to the Bihar geet tracks (parts 4 and 5).
Bihar-made ritual films cut on songs have very low view counts (under 1k), so quality is unproven.
Mehndi and haldi highlight films that name their song in the title have very few views (under 1k); popular haldi or mehndi films rarely say which song they use.

On the second pass, YouTube's bot check blocked description and chapter reads for the 8 newly added entries (yt-dlp -J asked for sign-in). Their song lists come from the titles only, so the meta stage should re-read their descriptions and chapters.
No Bihar-specific baraat DJ list (Bhojpuri baraat songs) or griha-pravesh song list was found in this track.
